description: Graph Workflow — state write validation hook (Trae). TEMPLATE, not loaded by Trae directly: Trae has no plugin-level hooks, so install-trae.js substitutes ${TRAE_PLUGIN_ROOT} with the installed plugin root at install time (Trae itself performs no variable substitution) and merges the hooks map into the global ~/.trae-cn/hooks.json (own entries identified by the 'graph-workflow-trae' path marker). Trae runs command hooks in the system default shell (PowerShell on Windows); exit 2 + stderr blocks. timeout is in seconds.
